<b>Skull Scuttlers</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are small, soft bugs using the skulls of [[the Marrow]] as protection and disguise.<ref>Skull Scuttler [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Small, soft bug that uses the hard skulls of the Marrow for protection and disguise."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Skull Scuttlers walk back and forth, turning around when they reach a wall or platform edge. They often hide inside the skull they wear, imitating harmless background elements until [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] comes close.

They deal {{Damage|1}} on contact, even before they have emerged from hiding.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Skull Scuttlers have their health quadrupled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
*Rumbling, crackling...
*Shells are strong...
*Scratching, seeking...
*Warm and dark...
*Digging, hiding...
*Claws are sharp...
}}

== Location ==
Skull Scuttlers are found primarily in [[the Marrow]], and a few appear in the [[Deep Docks]]. They can also be seen in the [[Memorium]]'s Marrow section.

A Skull Scuttler above the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/The Marrow 1|gauntlet]] arena in the Marrow can be permanently removed by dropping a platform on it.
